_comment: Provenance for WASM bundles built from the pqctoday-hsm repo and vendored into this hub. When you rebuild a bundle with its hsm build script, update its `hsmCommit`/`builtAt`. Verify drift with `npm run sync:wasm:check` (compares against a sibling ../pqctoday-hsm checkout when present; no-op otherwise). Bundles built from other sources (openssl upstream, pqctoday-tpm) are intentionally omitted.

bundles.name: cacp-kmip
bundles._buildNote: Prior rebuilds (2026-07-10/11, merged via hub #410/#411, hsm #139/#140): corrected a stale manifest entry, picked up CKA_ALLOWED_MECHANISMS/CKO_CERTIFICATE engine-side support, fixed the wasm32 compile break in Register/Import's certificate projection, and added the WP-4 raw_pkcs11_encrypt_probe showcase export. This rebuild adds the WP-3 showcase (`Pkcs11CertificateDemo.tsx`): a real fix (Register(Certificate) with a PublicKeyLink now reuses that key's own CKA_ID instead of minting a fresh one, matching the native Certify path — see hsm #141) plus two wasm exports, `register_certificate_demo` and `engine_certificate_attributes`. PENDING: hsm branch `feat/wp3-register-certificate-cka-id-sharing` (PR pqctoday-hsm#141) is not yet merged to hsm main as of this hub commit — update this note once it lands. Verified: native `cargo test -p pqctoday-kmip` (593 passed), wasm32 build + smoke test, and a standalone node script + a real-browser Playwright pass confirming a genuine Register → engine-projection → real CKA_SUBJECT/CKA_ISSUER/CKA_SERIAL_NUMBER/CKA_VALUE readback (not simulated).

bundles.name: softhsmrustv3-engine
bundles._buildNote: Rebuilt from pqctoday-hsm v0.14.0 (was genuinely 10 commits / ~7 functional behind — this manifest entry was accurate, unlike cacp-kmip's). Picks up: Split Key secret-sharing math + handle-based native API, HSS/LMS wired into native::sign + Register-import, the v0.13.0 gap-remediation audit fixes (Destroy scrubbing, attribute-mutation honesty, RSA-Register/Encrypt-Decrypt/Locate fixes), and the same day's PKCS#11 v3.2 gap-remediation pass (CKA_ALLOWED_MECHANISMS mechanism-mismatch fix, CKO_CERTIFICATE, Register/Certify parity, Re-certify collision fix, class-blind CKA_ID lookups, C_CopyObject trust gate, mechanism-length validation). Still built with --features acvp (required since 2026-06-27 for ACVP KAT seeding). Binary grew from 2,209,912 to 2,885,179 bytes (~30%), consistent with the real new compiled surface (FrodoKEM/Classic McEliece were already in this bundle from the prior build).

bundles.name: softhsm-cpp-engine
bundles._buildNote: Includes fix(cpp) 250994d: SP800-108 KDF now requires keyed-MAC PRF (CKM_SHA256_HMAC); bare hash IDs rejected per PKCS#11 v3.2 §6.42.

bundles.name: openssh-pkcs11
bundles._buildNote: Re-stamped, not rebuilt: verified `git log 07cd2e0e1..1c637d3 -- openssh-pkcs11/` touches only CHANGELOG.md and STATUS.md (2 doc-only commits, zero source/behavior change). No emsdk/Emscripten toolchain is installed on this machine, so an actual rebuild wasn't attempted or needed — the existing binary is bit-for-bit what v0.14.0's source would produce.
